plants.name: Annual Meadow Grass
plants.weed_management_notes: Fast-seeding annual grass. Keep bare soil covered and remove before seed heads mature.

plants.name: Bindweed
plants.weed_management_notes: Deep-rooted twining perennial. Suppressors help after repeated root removal, but dense cover alone will not clear it.

plants.name: Bramble / Wild Blackberry
plants.weed_management_notes: Woody perennial. Cut and remove crowns before replanting with dense ground cover.

plants.name: Broad-leaved Dock
plants.weed_management_notes: Deep tap-rooted perennial. Remove the root crown before using dense cover to stop seedlings returning.

plants.name: Cleavers
plants.weed_management_notes: Fast annual climber. Pull young plants before seed and keep beds covered with quick green manure.

plants.name: Common Chickweed
plants.weed_management_notes: Mat-forming annual. Quick cover crops and living mulch work well because it exploits open soil.

plants.name: Common Plantain
plants.weed_management_notes: Rosette perennial of compacted soil. Ease compaction and use dense ground cover.

plants.name: Couch Grass
plants.weed_management_notes: Creeping grass with wiry rhizomes. Remove rhizomes first, then use dense cover to prevent re-establishment.

plants.name: Creeping Buttercup
plants.weed_management_notes: Creeping perennial that roots at runners. Remove runners and improve dense ground cover.

plants.name: Creeping Thistle
plants.weed_management_notes: Deep-rooted perennial. Repeated cutting weakens it; cover crops help stop seedlings and bare-soil regrowth.

plants.name: Curled Dock
plants.weed_management_notes: Deep tap-rooted perennial. Remove crowns and prevent bare soil where seedlings establish.

plants.name: Dandelion
plants.weed_management_notes: Tap-rooted perennial. Remove crowns in beds and keep soil shaded with living mulch.

plants.name: Enchanter's Nightshade
plants.weed_management_notes: Shade-tolerant perennial with brittle roots. Remove roots, then use shade ground cover.

plants.name: Fat Hen
plants.weed_management_notes: Fast annual seed-setter. Smother young seedlings with quick summer green manures.

plants.name: Green Alkanet
plants.weed_management_notes: Deep-rooted perennial that seeds freely. Remove roots and prevent bare-soil seedling flushes.

plants.name: Ground Elder
plants.weed_management_notes: Creeping perennial. Remove rhizomes before planting dense shade-tolerant ground cover.

plants.name: Groundsel
plants.weed_management_notes: Quick annual seed-setter. Hoe or pull early and keep soil covered.

plants.name: Hairy Bittercress
plants.weed_management_notes: Explosive seedpods spread quickly. Keep soil covered and remove rosettes before flowering.

plants.name: Herb Bennet / Wood Avens
plants.weed_management_notes: Perennial weed of borders and shade. Dense ground cover helps after crown removal.

plants.name: Herb Robert
plants.weed_management_notes: Annual seed-spreader. Pull before seed and keep gaps planted.

plants.name: Horsetail / Mare's Tail
plants.weed_management_notes: Very deep perennial. Improve dense planting after control, but do not rely on suppressor plants alone.

plants.name: Japanese Knotweed
plants.weed_management_notes: Invasive regulated plant. Do not compost or move contaminated soil; use specialist control advice.

plants.name: Lesser Celandine
plants.weed_management_notes: Spring perennial with small tubers. Remove before it dies back and cover soil after control.

plants.name: Oxalis
plants.weed_management_notes: Persistent creeping or bulb-forming weed. Dense cover helps after careful removal of roots and bulbils.

plants.name: Prickly Sow-thistle
plants.weed_management_notes: Annual or short-lived weed. Remove before seed and use quick cover crops in open beds.

plants.name: Ragwort
plants.weed_management_notes: Toxic biennial or perennial weed. Remove safely before seed, especially near grazing animals.

plants.name: Red Dead-nettle
plants.weed_management_notes: Early-flowering annual. Pull before seed where unwanted; keep soil covered.

plants.name: Ribwort Plantain
plants.weed_management_notes: Rosette perennial with a strong root. Remove crowns and cover open soil.

plants.name: Rosebay Willowherb
plants.weed_management_notes: Tall perennial that spreads by rhizomes and wind-blown seed. Remove before seeding and cover open ground.

plants.name: Shepherd's Purse
plants.weed_management_notes: Fast annual brassica-family weed. Quick cover crops reduce open soil where it germinates.

plants.name: Smooth Sow-thistle
plants.weed_management_notes: Annual or short-lived weed. Remove before seed and cover bare soil.

plants.name: Speedwell
plants.weed_management_notes: Low annual or perennial mat-former. Dense ground cover reduces seedling establishment.

plants.name: Stinging Nettle
plants.weed_management_notes: Rhizomatous perennial and wildlife plant. Keep only where wanted; suppress regrowth after root removal.
